messages:
Alex: Quick note9am: the canary showed a race where manifest updates and loader prefetch overlap and produce a transient mixed-model view. We should make manifest updates atomic from the loader's perspective.
Priya: What if we version manifests and expose "apply_version" that the loader only switches to after fetching a small apply_token? That token could be content-addressed so loaders can verify integrity before swap.
Tanvi: +1. Token fetch should be cheap (metadata only) so we don't block on large blob downloads. Also, loaders should be allowed to delay applying for a short window if local IO is saturated. Maybe an "apply_deadline_ms" hint in token?
Raj: Agree with token. Implementation idea: manifest carries candidate_version and token_uri. Loader sees candidate_version != active, fetches token_uri, verifies signature/checksum, then does an atomic in-memory pointer swap. If verification fails, loader logs and continues with current active.
Alex: For backwards compatibility, if token_uri missing, loader can fallback to legacy filename-based swap but emit a warning metric. We should discourage legacy flows.
Priya: Telemetry: emit manifest.apply.attempts, manifest.apply.success, manifest.apply.deferred_due_to_io, and manifest.apply.verify_fail. ops-bot can you file a stub?
ops-bot: Created INF-9123: "Manifest apply token telemetry". Will emit metrics: manifest.apply.attempts, manifest.apply.success, manifest.apply.deferred_count, manifest.apply.verify_failures.
Tanvi: One more edge: streaming readers may have partial ranges from the old shards while token verification completes. We should support a short grace period where both old and new descriptors are retained until refcount drops. Add token.gc_grace_seconds field.
Raj: Good call. Default gc_grace_seconds=120. Also add token.mode: eager|lazy so publishers can request either immediate application or background lazy materialization.
Alex: Action items: Priya draft tiny RFC for apply_token schema + defaults; Tanvi extend loader to honor apply_deadline_ms and gc_grace_seconds; Raj wire the fallback metric; ops-bot will track INF-9123.
Priya: I'll open the PR tonight with examples and a small compatibility note.
Alex: Thanks all, should reduce those mixed-view incidents. :thumbsup:
